commonDiseases.name: Common Cold
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick people
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: If symptoms persist for more than 10 days or worsen

commonDiseases.name: Influenza (Flu)
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: If experiencing severe symptoms or shortness of breath - seek immediate medical attention

commonDiseases.name: COVID-19
prevention: Wear masks in crowded places if needed
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: If experiencing difficulty breathing or severe symptoms - seek immediate medical care

commonDiseases.name: Diabetes
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: If experiencing multiple symptoms, consult a healthcare professional for testing

commonDiseases.name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: Regular check-ups recommended for early detection

commonDiseases.name: Heart Disease
commonDiseases.when_to_see_doctor: If experiencing chest pain or severe symptoms - CALL EMERGENCY IMMEDIATELY

general: Wash hands frequently with soap and water
Maintain a balanced diet rich in fruits and vegetables
Exercise regularly for at least 30 minutes daily
Manage stress through meditation or exercise
Stay hydrated - drink plenty of water
Get vaccinated as recommended by health authorities
during_illness: Use a humidifier to ease congestion
Gargle with salt water for sore throat
Maintain isolation to prevent spreading to others
Monitor symptoms and seek help if they worsen

emergency_symptoms: Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath
Signs of stroke (face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty)
